answer_1.quote: We define SpeechRE as a joint entity and relation extraction task that takes a speech utterance as the input and generates a set of relational triplets in the form of [entity1, relation, entity2] as the output.
answer_1.outputs: relational triplets in the form of [entity1, relation, entity2]

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the baseline models and SpeechRE models based on the metrics (i.e., Recall, Precision and micro-F1) commonly used in TextRE, with modifications.
